stories.title: Claude Haiku 5.5
stories.reason: Anthropic's flagship cheap/fast small model refresh: 90% cheaper than Haiku 4.5 (<=100k tokens), big benchmark jumps (OSWorld 72.4% vs 15.7%, Terminal-Bench 39.2% vs 0%), first Haiku with adjustable effort.
key_facts: Input $0.10/$0.50 per M tokens (<=100k/>100k), vs Haiku 4.5 $1.00
Output $0.50/$2.50 per M tokens vs Haiku 4.5 $5.00
~75% cheaper on average to run than Haiku 4.5; 90% cheaper under 100k tokens
OSWorld 2.1 offline: 72.4% vs Haiku 4.5's 15.7%; Terminal-Bench 4.0: 39.2% vs 0.0%
First Haiku-class model with an adjustable effort setting
Asana reports >30% latency reduction, up to 2.5x faster inference per turn
Available on AWS, GCP, Azure, and the Claude Platform

stories.title: GPT‑6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
stories.reason: GPT-6 'Intelligent UI' rollout to all ChatGPT users, 470 HN points — a major platform-wide UX/model change from OpenAI, but couldn't fetch openai.com (egress blocked) to confirm specifics beyond the title.

stories.title: Docker Agent
stories.reason: Docker's own agent builder/runtime: declarative YAML agents, provider-agnostic (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Bedrock/Mistral/xAI), packaged and distributed as OCI artifacts — real running code (Apache-2.0, 3.9k stars, 10.7k commits), not just a demo.
key_facts: docker/docker-agent: AI Agent Builder and Runtime, invoked as `docker agent`
Agents defined in YAML; no code required; can be organized into delegating teams
Tools from built-in capabilities and MCP servers (local, remote, or Docker-based)
Agents packaged and pushed/pulled as OCI registry artifacts
Apache-2.0, 3.9k stars, 489 forks, preinstalled in Docker Desktop 4.63+

stories.reason: Utah reportedly allowing AI to examine patients and prescribe medication without human oversight — a consequential AI-deployment policy first, not a rumor (124 HN points).
